recorded.prompt:q-start-years:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-start-years:b: 'A value function that gives a project one number, computed at its earliest start, would miss both effects.'
recorded.prompt:q-start-years:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-start-years:c: P035's 'reliability, safety and environmental parts grow with delay', so the later start is not smaller in every measure.
recorded.prompt:q-start-years:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-start-years:d: 'one coefficient to each start variable... each start year needs its own'; a single averaged number contradicts this.
recorded.prompt:q-dollars:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dollars:a: The formula divides by w_fin ('points * reference / weights'); it does not multiply by it.
recorded.prompt:q-dollars:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dollars:b: The formula includes w_fin: v x R_fin / w_fin.
recorded.prompt:q-dollars:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dollars:d: The formula multiplies by R_fin and divides by w_fin.
recorded.prompt:q-plan-cap:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-plan-cap:a: 'a rule about the plan as a whole does not' stay linear. Only per-start computations can be done before the model is built.
recorded.prompt:q-plan-cap:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-plan-cap:c: 'below the cap each unit counts in full and above it not at all, which no single coefficient per start can say.'
recorded.prompt:q-plan-cap:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-plan-cap:d: 'A cap is not a smaller weight.'
